project_description.value: Design-Build renovation of approximately 650 SF of existing unfinished interior space in Building 45 at Naval Support Activity Philadelphia into a Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) Secure Suite meeting ICD/ICS 705 and UFC 4-010-05 requirements. The Secure Suite contains a Video Teleconference (VTC) Room, IT/Server Room, and Common Open Office area designed for 24/7 Continuous Operation. Scope includes architectural renovation; stand-alone HVAC system; electrical service with power line RF filters and Red/Black separation; telecommunications with CAT6 and fiber; fire protection/alarm modifications; electronic security system (ACS, IDS, CCTV); TEMPEST countermeasures including RF foil shielding; and all associated cybersecurity requirements. Building 45 was a newly constructed building opened November 2019.
project_description.quote: This project includes the complete design services as well as, all required labor, materials, equipment, testing and adjustments to convert an approximately 650-Square Feet of existing interior space in Building 45 located in the Naval Support Activity, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania into a secure area that meets the Intelligence Community Standard (ICS) Number 705-1 for physical security required for storing, processing, and discussion of sensitive information.

building_description.value: Building 45 is a newly constructed building (opened November 2019) located in a restricted fenced compound at Naval Support Activity Philadelphia. The work area was an unfinished space with concrete floor and exposed metal ceiling deck and metal beams. Temporary partition walls and doors had been installed to isolate the construction space from adjacent restricted access offices (Command Control Center).
building_description.quote: Building 45 in a newly constructed building (opened in November 2019) located in a restricted fenced compound at the Naval Support Activity Philadelphia. Access to the compound and the building are controlled. The work area located in Building 45 is an unfinished space with concrete floor and exposed metal ceiling deck and metal beams.

bfa_role_detail.value: BFA (Bowman Foster & Associates) served as the Designer of Record (DOR) — a subconsultant to or partner with the prime Design-Build contractor. The BOD was issued by BFA under BFA Project No. 20-084. The RFP defines the DOR as 'Licensed architect/engineer working as subcontractor to or partner with prime Contractor who provides design for this contract.'
